notes.title: Builder Edition is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937756/2fd8b1c3cb021e147e28d1f8af6142fc0f99300c.png[/img]

[h1]Now Released![/h1]
After 10 years, a fun free version of this game I've been working on is now released and free on Steam! I really did enjoy making this game over so long, that I wanted more people to honestly enjoy it. So I packed it full of fun extras for all to enjoy. I'm looking forward to all the new levels being created by the community.

[h2]Features[/h2]
- 100 Starter Levels to play - Giving you chance to learn the mechanics and have some fun
- 50 Bonus Levels - Even more free levels to enjoy
- Level Editor: Create and share your own unique levels with friends
- Block Database: Play more levels online from around the world from strangers and friends
- Can be played locally with friend with 2 controllers for puzzle co-op solving
- Leaderboards
- Achievements
- Cloud Saves - Sync up your levels across devices as well as with the Main Version

[h2]Why Builder Edition[/h2]
Drop It: Block Paradise! Builder Edition is a free spin off of my original puzzle game Drop It: Block Paradise. It's focus is on community built levels allowing players to make and play online levels for free. Think of Builder Edition as a nice complement to the main bringing in some fresh new created levels for all to play.

notes.title: Builder Edition Demo updated for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937756/2fd8b1c3cb021e147e28d1f8af6142fc0f99300c.png[/img]

The Demo for Drop It: Block Paradise! Builder Edition has been updated, just in time for Steam Next Fest! Featuring 50 hand crafted puzzle levels, ability to create your own levels and play other user created levels online!

On March 21st 2025, Builder Edition will fully launch on Steam for free! This will contain even more levels, totaling 100 total to wet your puzzle itch, fun achievements to unlock and of course custom made levels made by you and others from around the world!

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
The Demo version of Drop It: Block Paradise! Builder Edition is now available for all to try.

This Builder Edition focuses on the Level Editor & Online Database aspects of the game. So if you are feeling creative, try making a level and then upload it online for others to try. To help you get started, there are 50 free levels that come with the game to help give you the ropes of how the game works. Don't forget to checkout the countless levels created by others in the Block Database!

This Demo, along with the eventual full release version later this year, will stay in sync with the Main Paid game (Drop It: Block Paradise!) via Steam Cloud Sync so that you can pick right back up where you left off anytime, anyplace.

If you are curious about the Full Paid version, you can check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2265520/Drop_It_Block_Paradise/]Drop It: Block Paradise![/url]
